title: World BEYOND War Europe Berlin/Wanfried network expansion
summary: Advanced the unresolved WBW Europe edge by materializing current Berlin and Wanfried chapters, the regional Europe Network, explicit network membership for Berlin/Wanfried/Romania/Ireland, and three public organizing/leadership people.

provenance.method: bounded current first-party chapter/network expansion with repository deduplication

classification_rules: Treat current first-party chapter listings and chapter pages as explicit local_chapter_of evidence.
Treat the June 2026 first-party Europe Network participant listing as explicit member_of evidence.
Treat Heinrich Buecker, Wolfgang Lieberknecht and Annachiara Canetta roles as explicit public roles from first-party sources.
Preserve Berlin, Wanfried and the Europe Network as distinct organizations.
data.method: Follow the unresolved WBW Europe Network edge after Romania/Ireland; enumerate current Berlin and Wanfried chapter nodes, regional network structure and explicit public leadership/staff roles.
data.narrative_role: bounded chapter/affiliate and public-person expansion investigator
data.research_question: Which current WBW Europe chapter/network nodes and explicit public organizer roles can be materialized from first-party evidence in this bounded pass?

findings.finding: Current World BEYOND War Europe material lists Berlin and International Peacefactory Wanfried as chapters alongside Ireland and Romania.
A June 5, 2026 first-party World BEYOND War Europe Network letter explicitly lists Berlin, Wanfried, Ireland and Romania among network participants.
World BEYOND War first-party material identifies Heinrich Buecker as a Berlin chapter leader and Wolfgang Lieberknecht as Wanfried chapter co-coordinator/co-founder.
World BEYOND War's current staff page identifies Annachiara Canetta as Europe Organizer.
